biggest_catch: StockX takes roughly a tenth-plus off the top before you see a dollar: 9% transaction fee plus processing plus shipping, then another 2% if you cash out to a Visa debit card - and none of it exists until a buyer takes your Ask and the item passes verification.
catches: Seller fees are steep: 9% base transaction fee at level one, plus payment processing, plus a shipping fee - and Visa debit cash-out costs 2% (min $1.95, max $9.95).
Nothing sells until a buyer bids/buys at your Ask; price depends on market demand.
Verification can fail the sale if the item is not authentic or not as described.
You must ship quickly after a sale; late shipment penalties apply.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

c4.evidence: Listing/Ask is free; no upfront fee.

eligibility: 18+, must own the item; new/verified-authentic condition standards.
maximize: Sell during hype peaks (release week), not months later - resale prices decay fast. Set your Ask above your floor to absorb the 9% + fees; check Bid history to price it right. Ship immediately after a sale to avoid penalties.
